s: Din hannachat happarashiyyot battepillin ubo t' seipim: seder hannachat happarashiyyot shel rosh babbattim — qibbelu chakamim: "qaddesh" "vehaya ki yebiaka" — bimin haqqore, shehu haish haomed keneged hammeniach, u"shema" "vehaya im shamoa" — missemol haqqore, shehu yemin hammeniach. Vaapillu im hammeniach hu itter — en holekin achar yamin usemol shello, ella achar yamin usemol shel haqqore, dehaynu yamin usemol shel kol adam:
Veim hechelip ezeh parasha shennetanah shello bebetah hamyuchad lah — pesulin:

Veyesh beseder zeh machaloqet yeshana ben haggeonim harishonim, venechlequ gam ken bazeh rashi"y verabbenu tam. Rashi"y vesiato meporshim dibre chakamim: "shema" "vehaya im shamoa" missemol — semol zo hatchalatah hi meemtza rosh hammeniach, sheshte parashiyyot harishonot hen bismol rosh hammeniach, shehu yemin haqqore, ushette parashiyyot haacharonot hen meemtza harosh letzad yemino, shehu semol haqqore, utechillat semol zo hi parashat "shema" veachareha parashat "vehaya im shamoa", venimtza shepparashat "qaddesh" hu babbayit hachitzon shemmissemol hammeniach shehu yemin haqqore, veachareha "vehaya ki yebiaka", veachareha "shema" mimin hammeniach shehu semol haqqore, veachareha "vehaya im shamoa" babbayit hachitzon. Venimtza shehaqqore kesheqqore kedarko mimino lismolo — qore otan kesidran kemo shehen ketubot battora, shekkemo shekketibatan tzerika lihyot kesidran — kak hanachatan babbattim tzerika lihyot kesidran legabbe haqqore. Abal rabbenu tam vesiato meporshim mah sheameru chaza"l: "shema" "vehaya im shamoa" missemol — semol zo hatchalatah hi babbayit hachitzon shemmimin hammeniach shehu semol haqqore, vesham notenin parashat "shema", veachareha "vehaya im shamoa", babbayit hassamuk lo hammitqareb yoter limin haqqore. Venimtza shepparashat "shema" hi babbayit hachitzon shemmimin hammeniach, uparashat "qaddesh" babbayit hachitzon shebbismolo. Vesiman laddabar hu "shi"nin", dehaynu shi"nin shel "qaddesh" u"shema" etzel shi"nin shebbitzdade habbattim hachitzonim. Uparashiyyot "vehaya ki yebiaka" "vehaya im shamoa" — hen baemtza, vesiman laddabar "havayot" semukot zo lezo. Ulepi shekketibatan kesidran — ledibre hakkol, laken bapparashiyyot shel yad shehen niktabot biqlap echad — tzarik lehaniach chalaq parashat "vehaya im shamoa", veyiktob techilla parashat "shema" biqtzeh haqqelap, veachar-kak lepaneha parashat "vehaya im shamoa". Vetzarik lehaniach chalaq kede tesha otiyyot, besop shita acharona shebbeparashat "vehaya im shamoa", kede shepparashat "shema" shebberosh shita haelyona shebbaddap shelleachareha tihyeh parasha petucha, kemo shehi petucha battora. Veken tzarik lehaniach besop parashat "vehaya ki yebiaka", lehannohagim lehatchil parashat "vehaya im shamoa" berosh shita haelyona, kishar happarashiyyot. Abal lehannohagim laasotah setuma, umenichin lepaneha chalaq ketesha otiyyot berosh shita haelyona — en lahem lehaniach chalaq kede tesha otiyyot besop parashat "vehaya ki yebiaka":

Vehaiqqar kerashi"y vesiato. Veken minhag haolam. Veap-al-pi-ken, kevan shettepillin ellu pesulin min hattora lerabbenu tam vesiato — nimtza sharuy kol yamayv belo tepillin, laken kol yere shamayim yetze yede shenehem, veyaaseh shene zuge tepillin vinichem yachad, vikavven bahanachatan: beotan shehen kahalaka — ani yotze yede choba, vehashshear hen kirtzuot beolma, ki maqom yesh barosh lehaniach shene zuge tepillin, veken bazzeroa. Veyaniach tepillin shel rosh shel rashi"y lematta letzad happanim, veshel rabbenu tam lemala mehen (veken bazzeroa). Veap al pi shehammeniach shene zugot tepillin kesherot ober be"bal tosip", im hu mitkavven lammitzva bishnehem, veap im eno mitkavven lammitzva ella beachat mehen — ap-al-pi-ken asur middibre soperim, mikkol maqom kan shezzug echad hu pasul mimmah napshak — en kan mishshum "bal tosip" kelal, shehare lo asa ella mitzva achat, velo hosip kelum begup hammitzva zo, shezzug hashsheni omed bipsulo bipne atzmo, veeno shayyak kelal lazzug hakkasher, ella keshehu mitkavven lammitzva bishnehem — asur middibre soperim mippene shennireh kemosip, kemo shennitbaer besiman tarana:

Veim eno yodea lekavven hammaqom lahanichan yachad, o shechoshesh mippene hayyohara — yaniach shel rashi"y vibarek alehen shehen haiqqar, vehen yihyu alayv bishat qeriat shema utepilla, uleachar hattepilla yaniach shel rabbenu tam belo beraka, kede latzet ledibre hakkol. Veim libbo noqepo sheqqara qeriat shema belo tepillin lerabbenu tam vesiato, veheid edut sheqer beatzmo — yachazor veyiqra qeriat shema achar hattepilla parashat "shema" uparashat "vehaya im shamoa" shebbahen huzkeru mitzvat tepillin, veen tzarik lomar gam parashat "vayyomer":

Mikkol maqom, lo kol harotzeh littol et hashshem yabo veyittol, velo yaaseh ken bimqom haroim, ella mi shemmuchzaq umepursam bachasidut, shekkevan shehaolam nohagim kerashi"y — nirin lahem keyohara mi shechoshesh lehachamir al atzmo bazeh, im eno muchzaq lahem shemmachamir al atzmo gam ken bishar debarim:

Lo yanniach shette hazzugot bekis echad, ella yaaseh shene kisim vesiman lekol kis vekis, shello yitten shel zeh bazeh, lepi shezzug echad mehen hu chol, veasur lehannicho bakkis hamyuchad lattepillin, ella im ken hitna mittechilla alayv ken beshaa sheyyichado lekak, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman mab:
Veken lo yachalip habbattim veharetzuot mizzeh lezeh, ella im ken hitna mittechilla:

(Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemi shemmeniach shenehem yachad, shehu choshesh lebarek veliqrot qeriat shema beshel rashi"y lebaddo, mippene sheyyesh bazeh issur lerabbenu tam vesiato — yesh lo gam ken lachosh lerabbenu tam vesiato leinyan issur zeh lehishtammesh chol baqqodesh. Abal mi shemmebarek al shel rashi"y umeniach shel rabbenu tam achar hattepilla, kevan shessomek al shel rashi"y vesiato leinyan issur beraka lebattala mippene hahekreach, ap al pi shehu issur chamur shehismikuhu chaza"l al lav: "lo tissa et shem Hashem vego'" — yakol lismok gam ken bimqom hahekreach vehatztzorek leinyan issur zeh, sheggam ken eno ella middibre soperim, shello osra tora ella lehishtammesh beqodshe gaboah shel mizbeach veshel bedeq habbayit shemmoalin bahen, vekol maqom sheen meila — en issuro ella middibre soperim apillu beqodshe gaboah. Ulepikak, yakol littol retzua mishshel rabbenu tam leshel rashi"y kesheen lo acheret. Abal mishshel rashi"y leshel rabbenu tam — en littol bekol inyan):
